## Activity

West Gate Eye Clinic completed activity during May 2023, with 451 captures recorded. Session lists ran as planned apart from routine leave. The available activity indicates that the clinic maintained its scheduled photography service during the month. No operational issue was identified in the information provided.

## Image quality

There were 26 ungradable captures, representing an ungradable rate of 5.8 per cent. This result should be considered alongside the overall capture activity when reviewing image quality. The ungradable images were not suitable for grading, and the rate provides a summary measure of the quality of images obtained at the site during May 2023.

## Grading

Grading identified 102 referable results. The median lag from capture to grading was 2 days. This indicates that the midpoint time between image capture and completion of grading was 2 days. Overall, the report records activity at West Gate Eye Clinic, the associated image-quality outcome, and the grading results for May 2023.
